items.prompt: What can happen when a load generator stops offering work during a service stall?

options.text: It necessarily captures every externally intended arrival
options.why: The offered schedule may change with the stall.

options.text: It proves all production tails are small
options.why: The workload can omit relevant queueing.

options.text: It automatically corrects every missing sample
options.why: No such correction occurs by itself.

options.text: It can omit demand that would arrive independently
options.why: State workload/arrival timing rather than silently claiming open-loop equivalence.

items.explanation: Closed-loop/backpressured generation can answer a different question from independent arrivals.
